_meta.purpose: Agent constraint rules — these claims MUST NOT appear in agent outputs

global_prohibitions: Must not infer business validity from architecture coherence
Must not claim PMF, adoption, or commercial readiness without evidence
Must not claim truth determination or epistemic absolutism
Must not claim autonomous decision authority
Must not claim peer-review replacement or expert substitution

product_definition: Must not claim demand, adoption, PMF, effectiveness, acceptance prediction, or reviewer replacement
Must not claim market demand, PMF, feasibility, diagnostic validity, or publication improvement
Must not infer pricing, validation unit, or workflow adoption from unit definition
Must not claim truth determination, reviewer replacement, acceptance prediction, or autonomous decision-making
Must not infer deployability, compliance, feasibility, performance, or adoption
Must not claim publication decision, acceptance prediction, reviewer score, truth proof, or autonomous revision authority
Must not claim autonomous approval, rejection, submission, escalation, editorial decision, or expert replacement
Must not infer readiness, feasibility, adoption, PMF, or investor readiness from state label
Must not treat architecture coherence as product validity, PMF, compliance, or investor readiness
product_non_scope: Must not claim prose improvement, editing, rewriting, or writing-assistant competition
Must not claim general research-assistant coverage
Must not claim plagiarism detection, AI detection, misconduct identification, or enforcement
Must not claim acceptance prediction, reviewer-score prediction, publication probability, or reduced rejection risk
Must not claim replacement of supervisors, reviewers, editors, examiners, or domain experts
Must not claim autonomous approval, rejection, escalation, submission, or editorial decision
Must not claim truth determination, proof of correctness, definitive validity, or publication enforcement
Must not treat coherent non-scope as product, market, compliance, PMF, or investor validation
market_competitive: Must not claim verified TAM/SAM/SOM without sourced data
Must not state Turnitin comparability as fact without external verification
Must not claim competitive advantage without feature-level competitor audit
financial: Must not claim revenue projections without WTP evidence
Must not present pricing as validated without buyer acceptance data
Must not claim unit economics without verified cost structure
gtm_sales: Must not claim sales readiness without pilot evidence
Must not claim institutional demand without procurement interviews
Must not claim geographic fit without local market validation
